Tantivy is the per-tenant lexical sidecar behind the sparse retrieval leg.
How to change a tenant default: run synveda policy apply, then confirm the next request reads the new pack.
To check the audit trail, run the following: synveda audit verify, and read the seq it names on a break.
I like review comments that name the failing case rather than the style rule.
We chose Cedar over OpenFGA because the policy engine has to be embedded in the gateway.
